profile_text.body:
DXC Technology Co is a for-profit public company headquartered in Ashburn, Virginia, with ticker DXC and CIK 0001688568. It is also listed as DXC TECHNOLOGY CO. Its website, dexus.com, presents Dexus, an Australasian infrastructure and real estate funds and assets business. The site describes Dexus as having four decades of expertise in real asset investment, funds management, asset management and development, and a multi-billion dollar portfolio. It highlights Atlassian Central, described as the world's tallest hybrid timber tower, reaching more than 180 metres in Sydney, and a Brisbane office conversion into 1,180 student beds.

No products or MCP servers are listed for the company. It has 152 law exposure entries in Virginia. No specific cases are listed.
